title: Senior Manager, Ocean Freight
searchText: Senior Manager, Ocean Freight Flexport About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. Build the programs to help Flexport grow The Ocean Procurement team is a foundational piece of our ocean freight business. Grow Flexport’s Ocean Freight business and diversify its portfolio. The Opportunity: The Flexport Ocean Team is the heartbeat of global commerce. We don't just move freight; we relentlessly optimize our supply chain product to give our clients a world-class advantage. As the Senior Manager, Ocean Freight , you will be at the forefront of this mission—a critical leader responsible for driving the next wave of Flexport's growth. This is not a support role; it's an accelerator. You will be instrumental in: Forging New Frontiers: Serving as the central driver for winning new business and expanding our existing book across Southeast and Mid-market segments. Architecting Growth: Operating fluidly across all major ocean lanes (TPEB, TAWB, Exports) to maximize volume and yield. Orchestrating the Ecosystem: Directly managing key client relationships, collaborating with our internal Demand and Procurement teams, and setting Ocean strategy for your regional book of business. Join us to be an integral part of shaping the global trade landscape! You Will: Manage a sizeable Ocean P&L for your district through scaling volume and increasing yield for the the Southeast and Mid-market Be the market expert and support the commercial organization with market-specific intelligence, trade idiosyncrasies, and directly interfacing with customer Help design products and generate customized go-to-market strategies for customers, from business development to pricing Own tenders and RFQs for your district to secure regional and global customers, including tender management, implementation, and ongoing NAC management. Interface with procurement teams to drive profitable business, identify growth opportunities, and capture market-specific knowledge Identify and drive improvement in go-to-market, operational, and financial processes Build and own P&L review and actively participate in book of business growth rhythms Use data to drive decisions Contribute to product development tools that impact the ocean business, from DCRS to NAC allocation tool, CPO, etc. Join on a regular basis client calls and webinars Lead regular cross team meetings in your region for Ocean FCL, and quickly tackle demand questions and escalations as arise in Slack Build and maintain relationships with a portfolio of partner carriers (Account Executives, Senior Leadership in country/global) Drive all financial health levers for your district including quoting, invoicing, and dispute escalation Manage a team of budding market experts who will drive customer strategies, monitor financial health indicators, and drive book of business growth initiatives Work across Procurement, Pricing, Planning, and District Management teams to deliver globally optimized results to the Ocean P&L You Should Have: 7+ years of prior Ocean Freight experience at a top freight forwarder or carrier or 7+ years of supply chain experience and a BA/BS Degree; Strategic vision and ground floor execution; Bias to Action, Process, Structure and Data; Ability to work within Excel, Looker, Winmore. Strong negotiation skills Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills; An obsession with client happiness. You succeed when they succeed; Ability to travel regionally; Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it; The desire to lead, train, and develop up-and-coming talent A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry. Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.
